question.text: May the first reliability slice precede unfinished Knowledge K1-K9 acceptance?

proposal.title: Reliability sequencing
proposal.recommendation: Complete current Knowledge K1-K9 acceptance first. Alternative: explicitly permit only R1 closed boundary observations, incident persistence/search and read-only dashboard integration before acceptance, preserving all observer refusals and Knowledge obligations.
proposal.rationale: The latest recovery record explicitly leaves Knowledge acceptance open and excludes Reliability implementation until acceptance.
proposal.impact: Controls when R1 may begin; this does not authorize observer access, adaptive recovery or promotion.

question.text: Who may activate an evaluated Harness improvement?

proposal.title: Improvement activation authority
proposal.recommendation: Automatically collect incidents and draft proposals; require explicit developer approval for every activation initially. Security, authority and approval changes always require explicit human approval.
proposal.rationale: Failure evidence creates hypotheses rather than authority; existing spec and decision gates remain authoritative.
proposal.impact: No automatic self-modification or activation; later low-risk automation requires separate evaluated approval.

question.text: Which runtime security guarantee should the initial reliability work support?

proposal.title: Initial runtime boundary
proposal.recommendation: Guarantee supported supervised operation paths and document native host/provider authentication as a separate trusted boundary. Full hostile-host containment requires a separate approved design and qualification.
proposal.rationale: The operation sandbox intentionally leaves native authentication infrastructure outside the contained operation tree.
proposal.impact: Test supported alternatives/subprocess/delegation paths without claiming universal hostile-host isolation.

question.text: What retention and export policy should new reliability observations use?

proposal.title: Observation retention and export
proposal.recommendation: Keep closed records local with no external exporter initially. Propose 30 days for derived diagnostic detail; retain sanitized incident facts and version/evaluation/approval/rollout provenance until explicit retirement. Use bounded explicit backfill.
proposal.rationale: Existing storage is local and new telemetry must redact before persistence/export without importing private provider transcripts.
proposal.impact: New retention/deletion behavior needs exact approved policy; no external collector or raw transcript storage.

question.text: What evidence must be satisfied before promoting a Harness improvement?

proposal.title: Evaluation release standard
proposal.recommendation: Use a frozen paired benchmark, predeclared per-proposal improvement threshold, no material acceptance regression, zero demonstrated approval/isolation/privacy bypass, independent review and explicit activation approval. Missing or contaminated evidence cannot pass.
proposal.rationale: Current byte accounting and AL simulations do not establish general engineering-quality improvements.
proposal.impact: Evaluation thresholds must be fixed before results; canary stop conditions and rollback retain exact version provenance.

authority: Pending recommendations only; no verdict, sealed specification, execution or activation.
